strings.name: Dean Kamen
strings.summary: Dean Kamen began with portable infusion equipment and led DEKA teams developing dialysis, mobility and prosthetic technologies, as well as the Segway. He founded FIRST to advance youth engineering through robotics and later worked on regenerative manufacturing. He withdrew from FIRST in 2026 amid controversy over Epstein ties; FIRST said an independent review found no evidence of misconduct.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed medical and transportation devices and founded FIRST, advancing engineering innovation and youth robotics education.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended Worcester Polytechnic Institute; did not complete a degree
strings.highlights.h1.title: Medical and mobility technology
strings.highlights.h1.text: DEKA teams developed portable infusion, mobility devices and the LUKE prosthetic arm to address clinical needs.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Founding FIRST
strings.highlights.h2.text: He established the youth robotics organization; in 2026 he resigned from its board and withdrew from its activities.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Withdrawing from FIRST
strings.timeline.t1.text: Amid controversy over Epstein ties, he resigned and withdrew. FIRST reported no evidence of misconduct in an independent review; he acknowledged errors in judgment.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Tissue manufacturing
strings.timeline.t2.text: He led the ARMI team in the Defense Department-backed BioFabUSA tissue-biomanufacturing initiative.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Prosthetic arm authorization
strings.timeline.t3.text: The DEKA Arm System received FDA marketing authorization, later entering use as LUKE.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Introducing Segway
strings.timeline.t4.text: With his DEKA team, he unveiled an electric personal transporter controlled by shifts in body weight.
strings.timeline.t5.title: National Medal of Technology
strings.timeline.t5.text: He received the US medal for medical inventions and science education contributions.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Establishing FIRST
strings.timeline.t6.text: He founded the organization to engage young people in science and engineering through teamwork and robotics competitions.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Creating AutoSyringe
strings.timeline.t7.text: He established a medical-device company to manufacture and sell portable infusion pumps.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Student medical research
strings.timeline.t8.text: At Worcester Polytechnic Institute he explored precise long-duration drug delivery, later leaving without a degree to pursue entrepreneurship.
